source_grounding.call_chain_traced: PUT /collections/{name} without optimizers_config -> #[serde(default)] leaves OptimizersConfig.indexing_threshold = None (optimizers_builder.rs:83-84) -> threshold resolution deferred to OptimizersConfig::get_indexing_threshold_kb (optimizers_builder.rs:132-134) which delegates to the shared shard resolver lib/shard/src/optimizers/config.rs:176-182 -> None maps to DEFAULT_INDEXING_THRESHOLD_KB = 10_000 (config.rs:15), so the GET describe readback materializes 10000. PATCH /collections/{name} with an optimizers_config diff -> DiffConfig<OptimizersConfigDiff> for OptimizersConfig::update (config_diff.rs:251-279) applies indexing_threshold: indexing_threshold.or(self.indexing_threshold) (line 272): diff-None preserves the stored value and no code path injects any default on the update face; a whole-tree grep for 20000 hits only doc comments and proto annotations (config_diff.rs:150, collections.proto:291) plus unrelated bench/test numbers - the 20,000 'default' exists nowhere as a constant, default-fn or branch, and the value only appears in the runtime when a client sends it explicitly. The versioned spec prose is generated from these very doc comments, so the stale 20,000 sentence in the update-collection page is the verbatim child of the stale annotation at config_diff.rs:150.
